# env/components-creds.example.txt — infra-creds template for 00-support (### NN_Service format).
#
# REAL secrets go in env/components-creds.txt (GITIGNORED) — never in this committed
# .example file. Workflow:
#   cp env/components-creds.example.txt env/components-creds.txt
#   $EDITOR env/components-creds.txt        # paste your REAL infra creds (the full ### dump)
#   chmod 600 env/components-creds.txt
#   # paste auth's JWT_PUBLIC_KEY_B64 + INTERNAL_SERVICE_TOKEN into ### Auth_Identity below
#   ./env/init-env.sh .env.dev             # renders env/.env.dev  (DEV/STAGE only)
#
# init-env.sh reads env/components-creds.txt (gitignored). Paste your FULL infra status
# dump (all ### blocks); 00-support uses only these:
#   01_PostgreSQL 02_MongoDB 04_Redis 06_RabbitMQ 07_Elastic_APM.
# Other blocks are ignored — including 03_Elasticsearch (:9201), which is the
# search/review business ES used ONLY by 05-search + 08-review. The application
# log-sink ES is the APM-stack ES (block 07, :9200) — never block 03.
#
# 00-support is a VERIFY-ONLY service: it does NOT mint JWTs. Paste auth's PUBLIC key
# and the shared INTERNAL_SERVICE_TOKEN into the ### Auth_Identity block below (copy
# from 01-auth's rendered env/.env.dev). init-env.sh reads them block-scoped; if left
# as placeholders it falls back to AUTH_ENV_FILE=/opt/01-auth/env/.env.dev auto-discovery.

### 01_PostgreSQL
   endpoint       postgresql://<user>:<password>@<host>:5432/postgres
   host:port      <host>:5432
   user           <user>
   password       <password>

### 02_MongoDB
   endpoint       mongodb://<user>:<password>@<host>:27017/?authSource=admin
   host:port      <host>:27017
   user           <user>
   password       <password>

### 04_Redis
   endpoint       redis://default:<password>@<host>:6379/0
   host:port      <host>:6379
   user           default
   password       <password>

### 06_RabbitMQ
   amqp-url       amqp://<user>:<password>@<host>:5672/
   host:port      <host>:5672
   user           <user>
   password       <password>
   ui             http://<host>:15672

### 07_Elastic_APM
   elasticsearch  http://elastic:<apm-es-password>@<host>:9200
   apm-ingest     http://<host>:8200  (Bearer token)
   apm-token      <apm-bearer-token>
   kibana-ui      http://<host>:5601  (login: elastic)
   elastic-pass   <apm-es-password>

### Auth_Identity
   auth_service_public_key   <paste 01-auth .env.dev JWT_PUBLIC_KEY_B64>
   internal_service_token    <paste 01-auth .env.dev INTERNAL_SERVICE_TOKEN>
